brief:
Edit this raw talking-head video into a fast-paced 38-second Instagram Reel 
(9:16, 1080x1920, 30fps+) for a dental education page. Tone: energetic, 
punchy, meme-style teaching video with Tanglish (Tamil+English) voiceover.

STEP 1 - TRIM SILENCES:
Detect and remove all pauses/dead air longer than 0.3 seconds between 
sentences. Keep natural breathing pauses under 0.3s untouched.

STEP 2 - SPEED:
Apply a gentle 1.1x speed to the entire talking segments (do not pitch-shift 
the voice). For any remaining gaps/transitions between lines, speed those 
specific sections up to 1.4x.

STEP 3 - SEGMENT MARKERS (match audio to these beats):
- 0:00-0:03 = HOOK — add a punch-zoom effect on the word "wait", insert a 
  record-scratch/whoosh sound effect exactly on that word
- 0:03-0:07 = key teaching line, keep normal pace, no effects
- 0:07-0:13 = insert cutaway image of "lower lip swelling" reference photo 
  for 1.5 seconds, then cut back to face
- 0:13-0:20 = insert cutaway image of "floor of mouth swelling" reference 
  photo for 1.5 seconds, then cut back to face
- 0:20-0:26 = hold a static comparison graphic/flashcard full-screen 
  (Lower lip → Mucocele / Floor of mouth → Ranula)
- 0:26-0:32 = TWIST — add a suspense sting sound effect, punch-zoom on 
  "plunging ranula"
- 0:32-0:38 = CTA — direct energy, add end-card text overlay

STEP 4 - CAPTIONS:
Auto-generate word-by-word animated captions, bold white text with black 
outline, pop-in scale animation on emphasized words (MUCOCELE, RANULA, 
PLUNGING RANULA, WAIT). Manually correct any Tanglish words the auto-caption 
mistranscribes.

STEP 5 - MUSIC:
Add a trending upbeat background track at 12% volume with auto-ducking 
under voiceover.

STEP 6 - EXPORT:
1080x1920 vertical, captions burned in, H.264, high bitrate for Instagram 
Reels upload.
